subject: Important Update: Changes to Payment Terms
body: Dear valued customers, we wanted to inform you about some changes to our payment terms. Starting next month, all invoices will be due within 15 days of receipt. This adjustment is necessary to streamline our billing process and ensure timely payments. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding in this matter. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your continued support.
